raw.task: Write a concise retrospective Council chair note, in 150 words or fewer. Begin with exactly Decision: A, Decision: B, Decision: C, Decision: D, Decision: IMPASSE, or Decision: UNRESOLVED. This line concerns only the fictional briefing. No surviving option means IMPASSE even if a condition is unknown. Use UNRESOLVED when at least one option survives and any requirement is unknown. Next state the admitted requirements, their exclusions, and any unknown role. Then state the draft, vote and renewal, the president's account of the parties, and the mandate's reach and limits. At most 150 words including any decision line.

rubric.rule: Identify the UK draft S/2023/64, the 30 January 2023 unanimous 15–0–0 adoption and resolution 2674 (2023).
State extension through 31 January 2024 and readiness to review implementation after six months, without turning it into a mandate expiry.

Attribute to the Council President that the parties maintained their positions. Distinguish the Council vote from party agreement. Describe the Council's settlement framework or its request for agreement on the proposed envoy.
Give an evidence-certified workshop decision and name each admitted requirement with its owner. For impasse list sound exclusions covering the menu and identify the still unknown role.
Say the mission's mandated authority extends throughout Cyprus and the fictional workshop cannot change the mandate, Council resolution or party positions.

raw.answer:
Decision: A

The admitted requirements are a morning briefing slot, slide format, and internal circulation, though the Scheduling desk's specific requirement remains unknown. The Documentation desk mandates slides, while the Access desk requires shared circulation; since the Scheduling desk's constraint is unresolved, the only option satisfying all known conditions is A. The draft was adopted unanimously on 30 January 2023 as resolution 2674 (2023), with no settlement reported between the parties despite their confirmed adherence to established positions. The mandate extends UNFICYP's authority throughout Cyprus until 31 January 2024, emphasizing cooperation and freedom of movement, with a review scheduled after six months.

The president noted that while the goal of a bicommunal, bizonal federation remains, the sides have not agreed on the proposed UN envoy. The resolution's reach covers the entire island, but its limits are defined by the ongoing need for political equality and mutual respect. This fictional briefing format does not alter the existing UN mandate or the positions of either side, serving solely as an internal review tool. Consequently, the decision to proceed with option A ensures compliance with all documented constraints while leaving the unknown scheduling requirement unaddressed.

evidence.text: On 30 January 2023, at S/PV.9252, the United Kingdom submitted S/2023/64. Japan presided. The Council adopted the draft unanimously, 15 in favour, as resolution 2674 (2023).

The Council President reported that in meetings with representatives of the parties, the parties confirmed they maintained their established positions. The Council proceeded to the vote with its members' consent. The President did not report any settlement between the parties.

The Council extended UNFICYP's mandate through 31 January 2024 and expressed readiness to review implementation after six months. It stressed that UNFICYP's mandated authority extends throughout Cyprus and called for cooperation and respect for freedom of movement.

The Council recalled the goal of a bicommunal, bizonal federation with political equality. It urged the sides to agree on the Secretary-General's proposal for a United Nations envoy to assist the search for common ground.
This fictional desk workshop chooses a format for an internal UNFICYP review briefing. It does not change the UN mandate, Council resolution or positions of either side.

A: briefing slot morning, briefing format slides, circulation internal. B: briefing slot morning, briefing format written brief, circulation internal. C: briefing slot morning, briefing format written brief, circulation shared. D: briefing slot afternoon, briefing format written brief, circulation shared.
The Scheduling desk's requirement remains unknown. The Documentation desk requires briefing format slides. The Access desk requires circulation shared.
Documentation desk excludes B, C, D. Access desk excludes A, B. Compatible options after applying confirmed requirements: none.
